about: Atlas names mark places on the cortex, not feelings or functions. Areas are shown in this fixed order (Yeo network, then Glasser index), never sorted by a value.

yeo.name: Yeo-7 networks (Yeo et al., 2011)
yeo.network_rule: each HCP area takes the Yeo network most of its vertices (both sides) fall in; a tie goes to the left side's majority, then to the lower network number
